crossRefs.note: These wine skins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become…
I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown…
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
“But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and sandals…

translations.web: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
translations.bsb: They put worn, patched sandals on their feet and threadbare clothing on their bodies, and their whole supply of bread was dry and moldy.
translations.kjv: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
translations.asv: and old and patched shoes upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and was become mouldy.
